g.text: Checkpoint history in the scout's project modal
Is the project visible to scouts?
404 — the same as every other tab
Every checkpoint of the project, newest first — the running one on top

text.tspan: stage closed · goal met · goal missed
curator: person (avatar, name, speciality · level) or AI (robot)
direction by sprint, to the checkpoint goal and to the stage goal
One mark per sprint, each on its own
hover: the word and the curator's reason
the curator's speciality, opened as the curator picker opens it, no hiring offer

ul.li: The scout never receives the author's rating of the assessment, call notes, the curator's journal, the plan brief, prices or payments.
The checkpoint's tasks and expected outcomes are not shown — only its goal, verdict and directions.
Directions are read as stored by the sprint reviews, never recomputed.
Visibility is the scout card's own rule; this tab adds no wider one.
